newsitem.title: UK: CU extends gains on ABN bid talk.
newsitem.headline: CU extends gains on ABN bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc rose 2.5 percent on Monday, extending gains from Friday on speculation that ABN AMRO Holding NV may be interested in buying the company, dealers said.
At 1022 GMT, Commercial Union was up 17p at 696-1/2p, against a mostly flat insurance sector.
In Amsterdam, ABN AMRO traded 2.10 guilders higher at 46.90 guilders, after hitting a record high of 48.30.
Traders cited follow through gains from last week but cited no fresh news since a spokesman for ABN AMRO said on Friday that it would not comment on market rumours.
The ABN AMRO spokesman described the speculation as "old stuff".
Shares in Commercial Union, which tumbled from 767p in mid-May, have risen from a low of 628p on July 1 amid swirling rumours that it was a take-over target.
